text: This is a placeholder for a Google review. Once your Google Business Profile is connected in the admin, your top reviews replace it automatically, each linking back to Google.
Placeholder for a Yelp review excerpt. Yelp's API shares up to three excerpts per business, and each one links to the full review on Yelp.
Placeholder for an Angi review. Angi has no public API, so paste the review text and its link in Admin › Reviews and it appears here with an Angi badge.
Placeholder for a Houzz review, added by hand in the admin with a link to the original.
A second Google placeholder. Reviews are sorted with featured ones first, then by rating and date.
A third placeholder. Hidden reviews never show on the site, and you can link a review to a project so it appears on that project's page.
